source_read: Publisher full text (HTML), https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00213-024-06666-x, read in full in my own browser tab (tab-10), with the Crossref records of the notice (10.1007/s00213-024-06666-x) and of the retracted article (10.1007/s00213-019-05249-5) in the same tab. Step 1 (blind extraction) not run this round, per the round brief.

design.note: A retraction note; the schema has no notice value and narrative-review is the closest. I second reader 28's suggestion of a notice design, cited for the fact and stated grounds of a decision, with no risk-of-bias instrument (as METHODS 5.3 already provides for registry descriptions).

instrument.note: none-applicable; the checklist's domains read as questions about the notice as a source, as the reasoning says.

key_findings.note: Published 10 August 2024; volume 241, page 2405; issue date November 2024; 'The Original Article was published on 07 May 2019'; cited as Psychopharmacology (2019) 236:2735-2745, doi 10.1007/s00213-019-05249-5.

Word order kept, which is right: in the notice 'by researchers associated with this project' can attach either to the editors being informed or to the unethical conduct. The BMJ (Mahase, 2024) reads it as conduct by researchers; the claims should not resolve it.

Several authors; MAPS PBC a subsidiary wholly owned by MAPS; MAPS 'fully funded and provided the MDMA that was used in this trial', MAPS PBC organised the trial. The card keeps the notice's construction.

Feduccia agrees but disagrees with the wording; M. C. Mithoefer, Jerome, A. Mithoefer, Wagner, Yazar-Klosinski and Doblin disagree; Walsh neither; the remaining authors did not respond (Hamilton and Emerson by elimination from the 10 listed).

Crossref: notice vol. 241, issue 11, page 2405, online 10 August 2024, print November 2024, ten authors with M. C. Mithoefer first; update-to (retraction) from retraction-watch and from the publisher, both dated 10 August 2024, to 10.1007/s00213-019-05249-5; that record's title begins 'RETRACTED ARTICLE', print September 2019, vol. 236, issue 9, pp. 2735-2745, with matching updated-by links.

reporting_issues.note: The notice speaks of 'this trial' and of the data generated by the site, for a pooled analysis of six trials.
'The authors have subsequently confirmed' with no names.

risk_of_bias.note: Domains and overall are reasonable readings of an ill-fitting checklist; 'some concerns' records the notice's lack of detail rather than bias.

domains.note: The notice also does not say when the editors were informed.

domains.domain: Reliance on the authors' own studies
Balance of views on the retraction

missed: The syntactic ambiguity of 'by researchers associated with this project' (who informed the editors, or whose conduct it was) is worth a line in reporting_issues, because the news report resolves it one way.

The notice gives no date for when the editors were informed or for the violations themselves; the sponsor's own public statement of an ethical violation is dated 24 May 2019 by its URL (Mahase, 2024, ref 5), 17 days after this article was published online.
